title: Navigating the Rugged Data Landscape: The Impact of Data-Extrapolation Technologies on Knowledge Production
eligible_reason: Single adoption date. The treatment treat_ryr = bright_ryr_1998 x 1[year >= 2004] (Step1_ConstructData.do line 235): protein-sequence clusters that already had a solved structure by 1998 ('bright' clusters) are treated from 2004 onward, when molecular-replacement (data-extrapolation) technology became widely usable; dark clusters are controls. One common treatment year for all treated clusters, so the at-least-two-adoption-dates rule fails. Specifications are otherwise TWFE (reghdfe l1flow_tot3d_dyr treat_ryr, absorb(year id_numeric) cluster(id_numeric)) and a calendar-year event study (y`h'_bright_ryr for 1999-2019 with 2003 omitted, Figure 2).
design_notes: Cluster x year panel 1999-2019 (clusters discovered by 1998; cluster_panel.dta built by Step1 from PDB/UniProt inputs). Table 2 (Step2_Analyses.do lines 143-153): outcomes l1flow_tot3d_dyr = ln(1 + new structures deposited) and z1998flow_tot3d_dyr (levels), FE year + id_numeric, optional cluster_age and stock_total_recoded FE, cluster(id_numeric). Tables 3-6: outcome splits (published/unpublished, patents, function, resolution, R-free, citations, mentions, PI rank/experience). Figure 2: year x bright interactions, 2003 reference. The ft_callaway flag is not matched by any csdid/att_gt call in the code.
